title: A game event scheduler
description:
Run timed game events in order with a priority queue.

```
t=0.0  spawn goblin
t=1.5  goblin attacks
t=2.0  spawn bat
t=2.0  play music (added earlier, so first)
t=5.0  boss arrives
5 events run, 0 left
```

starter.main.lua:
local events = {}
local function schedule(at, name) events[#events + 1] = { at = at, name = name } end
schedule(1.5, "goblin attacks")
schedule(0, "spawn goblin")
for _, e in ipairs(events) do print(e.at, e.name) end

hints: Compare `{ at, seq }` pairs: time first, then a counter that grows with each `schedule` (lesson 8.01).
Cancelling sets `event.cancelled = true`; `run_until` simply skips such events when they come out of the heap.
requirements: A binary heap ordered by time, then by the order events were added.
`schedule(at, name, fn)`, `cancel(id)` and `run_until(t)`; an event can schedule new events.
Cancelled events are skipped without searching the heap (mark them).
stretch: Add repeating events that schedule themselves again every N seconds.
